name: AB Paragraphs
description: Provides an A/B test paragraph type with frontend session-based variant selection.
project_description: A/B Paragraphs adds a Paragraphs bundle called ab_test that lets editors place two content variants (Variant A and Variant B) side by side inside any paragraph-enabled field. On installation the module creates the ab_test paragraph type and six fields (field_variant_a, field_variant_b, field_tracking_code_a, field_tracking_code_b, field_unique_id, field_distribution). At render time both variants are output into a cacheable wrapper and a small JavaScript behavior picks one variant per browser session (sessionStorage), respecting the configured distribution ratio (50/50, 90/10, 10/90, 70/30, 30/70). Because selection is client-side, the page stays fully cacheable. The module does not do analytics itself: it fires Show/Click events into whatever analytics library is present on the page (Matomo/Piwik Pro via _paq, Google Analytics via gtag, GTM via dataLayer) and only when analytics consent is detected (Cookiebot, Klaro, Osano/CookieConsent, or a custom flag). A settings form at /admin/config/content/ab-paragraphs selects the analytics provider, and an editor helper suggests tracking-code snippets from links found in each variant. Two display modes must be enabled manually on the ab_test paragraph type after install.
